dboxTimeline.text: Under Bevelle, the flooded tunnels of the Via Purifico. Only three of them can swim.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Water to the ceiling. Where does this even lead?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay okay okay: we find the gate locks, we open them, we keep swimming!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: You make it sound easy, ya.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Eep! Something is moving down there. Something big. And, um, dead.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Don't let it look at you, brudda. Stone and water do not mix, ya.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It breaks. Whoever it catches just breaks. So nobody gets caught!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Its eyes, brudda! Whoever it looks at turns to stone!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: It was already dead. It just would not lie down.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Next stop is a temple under the sea, ya.
The Baaj Temple, deep under the water.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It swallowed one of us! Strike it from the inside, or brace for the spit!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Two down. Neither one was fair.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay okay okay: is everybody still in one piece? Be honest!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: More or less. Ask me again when I am dry.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: You kept your heads down and hit it hard, brudda. That is how.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay okay okay: next time we bring a bigger plan!
